info.title: JobPilot API
info.summary: Multi-agent job application assistant with human-in-the-loop controls

post.description: Free-text answers ("30 LPA", "60 days", "Pune, Delhi") parsed into typed fields.

Start reading a resume with the `extraction` model, through the harness. Returns at once;
follow the job at GET /profile/import/{job_id} (stages, live tokens and details found).

get.description: The import still running, if any: the page picks it up again after a reload.

post.description: Send a tiny structured request through the role's real route and fallbacks.

Search the chosen sources within the recency window (checkpoint H2). Runs synchronously;
with real portals this takes minutes because pages load at a human pace.
Add the postings on one URL (a careers page or a single job page), read by the LLM.

Manual: opens a visible browser on this machine and waits (up to 10 min) while you sign
in, including any CAPTCHA or 2FA. Password: fills the saved credentials; stops at any check.
Start an apply run: it pauses at H3 with the ranked list of found jobs.

Gmail / Outlook: returns the URL where you grant access; the provider then redirects
back to this API and the account is saved. Local: a folder mailbox for trying things out.
Apply the status an unverified email suggests, as your own (audited) decision.

Start a reply for this email (H6 → draft → H7), e.g. after a send was refused or an
email was set aside. Refused while a reply for it is already open.
